attack.combat_logic: Animation timing only; author hitboxes, damage and interruption in the game controller.

root_motion: None. Game controller supplies horizontal and vertical travel. Jump height in previews is simulated controller motion, not Action root keys.
jump_preview_note: Temporary render-only Actions supply jump height and forward travel for moving transitions. All gameplay root keys remain stationary.

rigid_frame_repair.cause: Solid frame meshes had vertices assigned to both thigh and shin bones, causing the frames to deform through the front thigh armor.

weapon_elevation.note: Aiming contribution only; torso locomotion lean is not globally clamped. Main bore has existing neutral ~2 degree upward cant. Target angles are offsets from neutral. Runtime target solver must compensate actual hull orientation.

weapon_elevation_verification.scope: All-frame root and angle checks; 29 sampled poses per clip for moving pod shells/covers/barrels and main barrel versus hull, stowage, hip and thigh armor. Embedded cannon trunnion/mantlet mating surfaces excluded; not an exhaustive every-object collision test.

numbering_note: Gallery labels and filenames were regrouped and renumbered. action and source_label retain the original Blender identifiers. Historical verification records use original source labels; match them using source_label.

death_animations_verification.scope: Every frame: stationary gameplay root, conservative skinned-vertex floor clearance, leg attachment, hinge axes and final hold. Sampled frames: thigh/knee shells, load frames, upper legs versus hull/pods, and main barrel versus thigh/knee/shin armor. Embedded bearings/mantlet and all other unlisted pairs excluded.

death_playback: Non-looping local corpse collapses. Keep CTRL.root stationary; bake CTRL.death_fall and evaluated mechanical bones. Stop locomotion and hold the final frame, or transition to an engine ragdoll explicitly.

dodge_animations_verification.scope: All 124 frames: stationary gameplay root, conservative body and exact cached sole clearance with supplied controller trajectory, airborne feet, landing foot locking, joint attachment, matching neutral endpoints, and intersections for listed thigh/knee/load-frame/hull/pod/shin/instep/barrel pairs. Ram also checks moving pod armor against both hull sections at all 31 frames and right shoulder leading at impact. Not an exhaustive every-object collision check.

dodge_controller_note: Apply each clip controller_samples translation relative to dodge start, rotated by the character heading. Gameplay roots remain zero. Positive X is mech-left; negative Y is forward; positive Z is up. Do not also extract the preview movement as root motion.

terrain_revision_verification.scope: All 681 Action frames: stationary roots, cached sole clearance against the analytic reference terrain, planted surface contact, foot targets, mechanical hinge axes, loop endpoints, and selected thigh/knee/load-frame/hull/pod/shin/instep/barrel mesh pairs. Not an exhaustive every-object collision check. Rendered terrain is a sampled approximation of the analytic surface.

dance_party_verification.scope: All frames: stationary root, conservative body floor clearance, planted-foot movement, leg joint attachment, loop endpoints, selected leg armor pairs and moving pod armor against the hull. Not an exhaustive all-object collision check.
